dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Oh well, an adventurer gave this to me previously... He said that it's a watch that brings you luck.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I mean, I found Dad again, so I guess it must be a lucky watch after all!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I'll give it to you now. I sure hope it brings you as much luck as it did me!
